senses.en: loud and noisy in protest or demand

example.en: The clamorous crowd demanded an answer.
example.zh: 喧闹的人群要求得到答复。

senses.en: a large European flatfish valued as food; also its flesh

example.en: We ordered grilled turbot at the restaurant.
example.zh: 我们在餐厅点了烤大菱鲆。

senses.en: a sudden forced entry into a place

example.en: The sudden irruption of reporters startled everyone in the office.
example.zh: 记者们的突然闯入让办公室里的每个人都吃了一惊。

senses.en: a sudden sharp increase in an animal population

example.en: The irruption of owls into southern areas happens some winters.
example.zh: 有些冬天会出现猫头鹰大量南下的现象。

senses.en: used to express surprise or mild shock

example.en: Gosh, I didn't expect to see you here!
example.zh: 天哪，我没想到会在这儿见到你！

senses.en: a small round bread roll, often sweet

example.en: He ate a currant bun with his tea.
example.zh: 他喝茶时吃了一个葡萄干小圆面包。

senses.en: hair twisted into a round shape at the back of the head

example.en: She tied her hair up in a bun before work.
example.zh: 上班前她把头发盘成了一个发髻。

senses.en: great skill or ability

example.en: His prowess on the basketball court impressed the scouts.
example.zh: 他在篮球场上的出色技艺给球探留下了深刻印象。

senses.en: shares representing ownership in a company

example.en: He owns stock in several technology companies.
example.zh: 他持有几家科技公司的股票。

senses.en: goods or supplies kept for sale or future use

example.en: The store has a large stock of winter coats.
example.zh: 这家商店有大量冬季外套库存。

senses.en: to keep goods available for sale or use

example.en: The shop stocks local produce.
example.zh: 这家商店备有本地农产品。

senses.en: Things made or grown for sale; merchandise.

example.en: The store sells household goods at low prices.
example.zh: 这家商店以低价出售家居用品。

senses.en: Possessions or movable property.

example.en: He packed his goods into the truck.
example.zh: 他把自己的物品装进了卡车。

senses.en: having come into life by birth

example.en: The baby was born at dawn.
example.zh: 婴儿在黎明时出生。

senses.en: having a natural ability or quality from birth

example.en: She is a born leader.
example.zh: 她天生就是领导者。

senses.en: resulting from or caused by something

example.en: The idea was born of necessity.
example.zh: 这个想法源于需要。

senses.en: to admit or accept that something is true or exists

example.en: She acknowledged that she had made a mistake.
example.zh: 她承认自己犯了一个错误。

senses.en: to confirm that you have received something

example.en: Please acknowledge receipt of this letter.
example.zh: 请确认收到这封信。

senses.en: to express thanks or recognition for something

example.en: The company acknowledged her long service with a gift.
example.zh: 公司送了一份礼物，感谢她长期的服务。

senses.en: to refuse to accept, approve, or agree to something

example.en: The committee rejected the proposal after a short discussion.
example.zh: 委员会简短讨论后否决了该提案。

senses.en: a person or thing that is rejected as unsuitable or defective

example.en: The shop sells factory rejects at a discount.
example.zh: 这家商店打折出售工厂次品。

senses.en: violent, cruel, or extremely fierce

example.en: The savage storm destroyed several houses along the coast.
example.zh: 这场凶猛的风暴摧毁了沿海的几座房屋。

senses.en: to attack someone or something brutally, or to criticize very harshly

example.en: The newspapers savaged the government's new policy.
example.zh: 报纸猛烈抨击了政府的新政策。

senses.en: (old-fashioned, offensive) a person considered uncivilized or primitive
senses.zh: 野蛮人；未开化的人（旧用法，含冒犯意味）

example.en: Old novels often portrayed indigenous peoples as savages, a view now rejected as prejudiced.
example.zh: 旧小说常把原住民描绘成野蛮人，这种观点如今被视为偏见而遭到否定。

senses.en: impressive grandeur or dignity of appearance or manner

example.en: The mountains rose in all their majesty.
example.zh: 群山雄伟壮观地耸立着。

senses.en: royal power or authority, used in titles like Your Majesty or Her Majesty
senses.zh: 君权；陛下（用于对君主的尊称）

example.en: Your Majesty, the ambassador has arrived.
example.zh: 陛下，大使已经到了。

senses.en: more quickly; at an earlier time

example.en: The sooner you start, the sooner you will finish.
example.zh: 你越早开始，就越早完成。

senses.en: more willingly; would prefer to

example.en: I would sooner walk than wait for the bus.
example.zh: 我宁愿走路也不愿等公交车。

senses.en: comparative of great; larger, more important, or more in degree

example.en: This problem is of greater importance than the last one.
example.zh: 这个问题比上一个更重要。

senses.en: an activity you enjoy doing in your free time

example.en: Photography is her favorite hobby.
example.zh: 摄影是她最喜欢的爱好。

senses.en: a center of activity, transport, or business

example.en: The city has become a major technology hub.
example.zh: 这座城市已成为重要的科技中心。

senses.en: the central part of a wheel where the axle passes through

example.en: The mechanic checked the wheel hub for damage.
example.zh: 技师检查了轮毂是否损坏。

senses.en: a group of students taught together; a lesson

example.en: There are twenty students in my class.
example.zh: 我们班有二十名学生。

senses.en: a group of people or things with shared characteristics; social rank

example.en: The middle class has grown rapidly in recent decades.
example.zh: 近几十年来中产阶级增长迅速。

senses.en: to put people or things into groups according to type

example.en: The books are classed by subject.
example.zh: 这些书按主题分类。

senses.en: happening after the usual or expected time

example.en: Sorry, I'm late—the bus was delayed.
example.zh: 抱歉，我迟到了——公交车晚点了。

senses.en: near the end of a period of time

example.en: He returned home in the late afternoon.
example.zh: 他傍晚时分回到家。

senses.en: no longer alive (used before a person's name)

example.en: She inherited the farm from her late husband.
example.zh: 她从已故的丈夫那里继承了农场。

senses.en: after the usual or expected time

example.en: I stayed up late to finish my homework.
example.zh: 我熬夜到很晚才完成作业。

senses.en: how heavy something is, measured as a force of gravity on it

example.en: Please check the weight of your luggage before going to the airport.
example.zh: 去机场前请先查看你行李的重量。

senses.en: a heavy object used in exercise to build muscle
senses.zh: 哑铃；杠铃片（健身用重物）

example.en: He lifts weights at the gym twice a week.
example.zh: 他每周去健身房举两次重。

senses.en: the importance or influence of something

example.en: Her opinion carries a lot of weight in the company.
example.zh: 她的意见在公司里很有分量。

senses.en: to make statistics or a decision consider some factors more heavily (often passive)

example.en: The final score is weighted toward the written exam.
example.zh: 最终成绩向笔试部分加权。

senses.en: a section of text in a book or speech

example.en: She read a short passage from the novel aloud.
example.zh: 她大声朗读了小说中的一段。

senses.en: a way through, such as a corridor or channel

example.en: A narrow passage leads to the garden.
example.zh: 一条狭窄的通道通向花园。

senses.en: the act of going through or across a place; the process of time passing
senses.zh: 通过；通行；航行；（时间的）流逝

example.en: The ship made the passage in three days.
example.zh: 这艘船用三天时间完成了航行。

senses.en: a person who oversees and directs the work of others

example.en: Please ask your supervisor before leaving early.
example.zh: 请先问过你的主管再提早离开。

senses.en: a person who guides a student's research or thesis

example.en: Her supervisor gave detailed feedback on her thesis.
example.zh: 她的导师对她的论文给出了详细的反馈。

senses.en: uncompromisingly committed; intensely loyal

example.en: He is a hardcore fan of the team.
example.zh: 他是这支球队的铁杆球迷。

senses.en: (of content) extremely explicit, especially sexually

example.en: The review described the film as hardcore pornography.
example.zh: 影评将这部影片称为露骨色情作品。

senses.en: to send someone back to their home country

example.en: The government agreed to repatriate the refugees.
example.zh: 政府同意遣返难民。

senses.en: to return to one's home country

example.en: Many workers repatriated after the contract ended.
example.zh: 合同结束后许多工人回国了。

senses.en: a bishop of the highest rank

example.en: The archbishop led the ceremony.
example.zh: 大主教主持了仪式。

senses.en: a fortified wine from southern Spain, drunk as an aperitif

example.en: We had a glass of sherry before dinner.
example.zh: 我们晚餐前喝了一杯雪利酒。

senses.en: (British, informal) a child's word for mother

example.en: Mummy, can I have a cookie?
example.zh: 妈妈，我能吃块饼干吗？

senses.en: a preserved dead body wrapped for burial, as in ancient Egypt

example.en: The museum displays an ancient Egyptian mummy.
example.zh: 博物馆展出了一具古埃及木乃伊。

senses.en: relating to the economy of a whole country or region

example.en: The government introduced new macroeconomic policies.
example.zh: 政府推出了新的宏观经济政策。

senses.en: growing thickly and densely, like a bush

example.en: He has a bushy beard and thick eyebrows.
example.zh: 他留着浓密的胡须，眉毛很粗。

senses.en: calmly enduring pain or hardship without complaining

example.en: He remained stoic during the long ordeal.
example.zh: 在漫长的磨难中他始终坚忍。

senses.en: a person who endures pain or hardship without complaint

example.en: She was a stoic who never mentioned her difficulties.
example.zh: 她是个坚忍的人，从不提自己的困难。

senses.en: shaped like or having the form of a tube

example.en: The flowers have long tubular shapes.
example.zh: 这些花呈细长的管状。

senses.en: a state of being empty, ruined, or destroyed

example.en: The abandoned village was a scene of complete desolation.
example.zh: 这座废弃的村庄满目荒凉。

senses.en: a feeling of great sadness and loneliness

example.en: She felt deep desolation after her friends moved away.
example.zh: 朋友们搬走后，她感到深深的孤寂。

senses.en: to hand something to someone or let them have it

example.en: She gave me the keys before leaving.
example.zh: 她离开前把钥匙给了我。

senses.en: to provide or supply something such as advice, help, or information
senses.zh: 提供；给予（建议、帮助、信息等）

example.en: The teacher gave us clear instructions.
example.zh: 老师给了我们明确的指示。

senses.en: to perform or present something in public

example.en: She gave a short speech at the ceremony.
example.zh: 她在仪式上作了简短的演讲。

senses.en: to make something clear by describing it in detail

example.en: She explained the rules before the game started.
example.zh: 比赛开始前她解释了规则。

senses.en: to give a reason or justification for something

example.en: He explained why he was late.
example.zh: 他解释了自己迟到的原因。

senses.en: the way a person or animal acts

example.en: Her calm behavior helped everyone stay relaxed.
example.zh: 她冷静的举止帮助大家保持放松。

senses.en: the way something works or responds

example.en: The behavior of the material changes when it gets wet.
example.zh: 这种材料遇水后表现会发生变化。

senses.en: actions considered in terms of right or wrong

example.en: The teacher praised the students for their good behavior.
example.zh: 老师表扬了学生们良好的品行。

senses.en: an unexpected event or fact

example.en: The party was a pleasant surprise.
example.zh: 这个聚会是个令人愉快的惊喜。

senses.en: to make someone feel astonished because something is unexpected

example.en: The news surprised everyone.
example.zh: 这个消息让所有人都感到惊讶。

senses.en: the feeling caused by something unexpected

example.en: She looked at him in surprise.
example.zh: 她惊讶地看着他。

senses.en: unexpected and done without warning

example.en: They planned a surprise visit.
example.zh: 他们计划了一次突然造访。

senses.en: the study or rules of correct reasoning
senses.zh: 逻辑；正确推理的规则或学科

example.en: She studied logic at university.
example.zh: 她在大学学习逻辑学。

senses.en: a particular system or way of reasoning

example.en: The two programs use different logic.
example.zh: 这两个程序使用不同的逻辑。

senses.en: sensible reason or judgment

example.en: There is no logic in staying up so late.
example.zh: 熬夜到这么晚没有道理。

senses.en: the sound made when someone walks

example.en: I heard footsteps in the hallway.
example.zh: 我听到走廊里有脚步声。

senses.en: a single step taken while walking

example.en: With each footstep, the frozen snow crackled.
example.zh: 每走一步，冻雪都嘎吱作响。

senses.en: a spicy root used in cooking

example.en: Add some fresh ginger to the soup for flavor.
example.zh: 在汤里加些鲜姜调味。

senses.en: bright orange-brown, especially of hair or fur

example.en: She has ginger hair.
example.zh: 她有一头姜黄色头发。

senses.en: a bright orange-brown color

example.en: The cat is a lovely shade of ginger.
example.zh: 这只猫是可爱的姜黄色。

senses.en: to add ginger to food for flavor

example.en: Ginger the sauce before serving.
example.zh: 上桌前在酱汁里加点姜。

senses.en: the time in the evening when the sun goes down below the horizon

example.en: We watched the sunset from the beach.
example.zh: 我们在海滩上观看日落。

senses.en: the colorful appearance of the sky when the sun goes down

example.en: The sky was filled with orange and pink at sunset.
example.zh: 日落时天空中满是橙色和粉色。

senses.en: intended or planned to end after a fixed period
senses.zh: （条款等）有截止期的；（行业等）衰落的

example.en: The contract includes a sunset clause.
example.zh: 该合同包含一条截止条款。

senses.en: a new or different way of explaining or understanding something

example.en: The film offers a modern reinterpretation of a classic novel.
example.zh: 这部电影对一部经典小说进行了现代的重新诠释。

senses.en: an artist or writer associated with surrealism, a movement using dreamlike imagery and unexpected combinations

example.en: The painter Dalí was one of the most famous surrealists.
example.zh: 画家达利是最著名的超现实主义者之一。

senses.en: relating to surrealism and its dreamlike or unexpected imagery

example.en: The museum displayed surrealist paintings.
example.zh: 博物馆展出了超现实主义绘画。

senses.en: a rented room that serves as both a bedroom and living room

example.en: She rented a small bedsit near the station.
example.zh: 她在车站附近租了一间小单间。

senses.en: an act of plundering or destructive attack, usually in the plural

example.en: The village suffered the depredations of invading armies.
example.zh: 村子遭受了入侵军队的劫掠。

senses.en: impossible to deny or disprove
senses.zh: 无可辩驳的；不容置疑的

example.en: The DNA test provided incontrovertible evidence.
example.zh: DNA检测提供了无可辩驳的证据。

senses.en: strong religious devotion and respect for God

example.en: She was known for her deep piety.
example.zh: 她以虔诚闻名。

senses.en: respect and devotion shown to parents or family (filial piety)

example.en: Confucian culture emphasizes filial piety.
example.zh: 儒家文化强调孝道。

senses.en: a pattern of lines that cross each other

example.en: The map was covered with crisscrosses of roads and rivers.
example.zh: 地图上布满了纵横交错的道路和河流。

senses.en: to move or travel back and forth across an area in crossing lines
senses.zh: 交叉往来；纵横交错地穿行

example.en: The reporters crisscrossed the city looking for news.
example.zh: 记者们在城中四处奔波寻找新闻。

senses.en: marked with lines that cross each other

example.en: The old table had a crisscross design on top.
example.zh: 那张旧桌子的桌面有十字形花纹。

senses.en: relating to melody

example.en: The song has a simple melodic structure that is easy to remember.
example.zh: 这首歌有简单易记的旋律结构。

senses.en: pleasant to listen to; tuneful

example.en: Her melodic voice soothed the whole audience.
example.zh: 她悦耳的嗓音抚慰了全场听众。

senses.en: a small spot or stain, especially of ink

example.en: There was a blot of ink on the page.
example.zh: 书页上有一块墨水渍。

senses.en: to make a spot or mark on something

example.en: Rain blotted the ink on the letter.
example.zh: 雨水弄花了信上的墨迹。

senses.en: something that spoils or damages a good reputation or record

example.en: The scandal was a blot on his career.
example.zh: 那桩丑闻是他职业生涯中的一个污点。

senses.en: to torment someone by showing something desirable that stays out of reach

example.en: The smell of fresh bread tantalized the hungry children.
example.zh: 新鲜面包的香味逗弄着饥饿的孩子们。
